satisfied: Exactly once, including the deploy: charge and guarded processed_at update commit in one transaction; record_charge skips an event_id that already has a charge, so a charge the old code committed before a hard stop is not repeated; the deploy replaces the replica, so old and new never run at the same time.
Notifications: sent before the commit, so a crash repeats a send (ignored per event_id) and never loses one; the 2-second timeout bounds lock time; the outage stall is a stated tradeoff.
Other callers: charge() keeps committing; manual charges have a NULL event_id and are never looked up, so the admin CLI is unchanged.
Rollback: no column or data change; the one additive index is ignored by the previous version.

concerns.summary: While the notification service is down the queue stalls (as today). A metric on the age of the oldest unprocessed event would make that visible.
